# ghost/tally-counter

Counter tally app (F-Droid): create a named counter, count up by tapping, list every counter with its value. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/tally-counter
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/tally-counter add_counter --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/tally-counter increment_counter --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/tally-counter get_counters --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tally-counter select_counter --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/tally-counter reset_counter --device <serial> --param name=<name>
```

## Actions

- `add_counter`: Create a counter called Groceries
- `increment_counter`: Add 3 to the Groceries counter
- `get_counters`: Show all my tally counters
- `select_counter`: Switch to the Groceries counter
- `reset_counter`: Reset the Groceries counter to zero
